introSlideshow.slide0.title: Welcome to Focus
introSlideshow.slide0.description:
Workspace for organizing web links, articles, 
quick notes, files and documents — all in one place

Focus is your knowledge hub for business,
workflows and learning processes

Best for:
- collecting and sharing ideas, sources
- effecient brainstorming and research 
- seamless and fast interactions between files, links, and notes

Enjoy staying focused!
introSlideshow.slide1.title: 385 file types supported
introSlideshow.slide1.description: Documents, audio, video, images, PDF, ebooks, presentations, spreadsheets and many more. Drop, open and preview directly in Focus
introSlideshow.slide2.title: Connect everything visually
introSlideshow.slide2.description:
Draw arrows between any objects to create visual graphs.
See how your ideas, links and files relate to each other.
introSlideshow.slide3.title: Quick notes
introSlideshow.slide3.description:
Add text notes anywhere on the center pane
Notes are automatically saved
introSlideshow.slide4.title: Share in one click
introSlideshow.slide4.description:
Share any object or entire space instantly via all popular platforms
Your audience doesn't need Focus to view shared content
introSlideshow.slide5.title: Single-click: for quick preview
introSlideshow.slide5.description:
You can navigate between links and files inside the preview pane
either on the right preview pane or in full window mode
introSlideshow.slide6.title: Double-click: to open files in your favorite app
introSlideshow.slide6.description:
For deeper interactions with files (for instance, to edit them)
open them in any external app
introSlideshow.slide7.title: For quick access, use shortcuts:
introSlideshow.slide7.description:
Create new space: Ctrl+Y
Add object: Ctrl+I
Toggle preview pane: Ctrl+U
Undo/Redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z
Open/Close left sidebar: Ctrl+ ←/→
Navigate spaces on the left sidebar: Ctrl+↑/↓
